summary.description: Demonstration dataset scenes: 500 episodes of wobbly_stand, one scene each. Development split only; these scenes are not part of the evaluation registry (../registry), whose evaluation kitchens, styles and held-out structure classes they do not use.
summary.origin_note: origin: the instance file's own origin record where it has one (kind minted-candidate: minted after the suite v1 freeze from the development kitchens, minted_after_freeze true), else "demo scene"; in_suite_registry: the same id is a development row of ../registry (byte-identical instance file).
summary.sanitizing_note: Internal server paths in an instance's origin record (registry / staging) are replaced by "internal" (sanitized true); nothing else in the file changes, so the instance_id still recomputes from task, generator_version, layout, style and spec. source_sha256 is the sha256 of the unsanitized source file.
